record_json: {"key": "australia_crcp_25d1d8c52b2d", "registry": "australia_crcp", "name": "Transforming Nickel Ore Processing with Low-Cost Low-Emission Molten Sulfur", "country": "AU", "round": "Successful CRC Projects Round 17", "period": "1 Sep 2025 – 27 Sep 2027", "grant": "$3,000,000", "project_value": "$7,807,121", "objective_original": "This project aims to develop a low-cost and low-emission alternative to High-Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) for nickel laterites. record_json: {"key": "australia_crcp_1988d0f31916", "registry": "australia_crcp", "name": "Vertiia: Electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing Passenger Aircraft", "country": "AU", "round": "Successful CRC Projects Round 8", "period": "1/1/2020 - 31/12/2021", "grant": "$3,000,000", "project_value": "$11,027,757", "objective_original": "This project enables the acceleration and optimisation of Vertiia, a passenger carrying and aeromedical electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, to be the most efficient and longest range eVTOL aircraft globally. original_name: Nanoparticle manufacturing and its application in brain cancer radiotherapy
record_json: {"key": "australia_crcp_38483b031758", "registry": "australia_crcp", "name": "Nanoparticle manufacturing and its application in brain cancer radiotherapy", "country": "AU", "round": "Successful CRC Projects Round 13", "period": "1 Oct 2022 - 30 Sept 2025", "grant": "$3,000,000", "project_value": "$8,034,360", "objective_original": "Ferronova is a SME developing super-paramagnetic iron-oxide nanoparticles (SPIONs) for image guided cancer surgery and therapy. This vision aligns with Siemens, a global leader in cancer imaging and radiotherapy. Nanotechnology has been widely researched in oncology, but clinical translation has been limited by complex manufacturing and limited effectiveness in vivo. The CRC-P will address these issues to develop commercial scale manufacturing of Ferronova’s FerroTrace SPION platform, with the testbed being FerroTrace-FAPi, a preclinically validated theranostic product for image guided radiotherapy and proton therapy. original_name: Edge AI for Zero-Defect Automated Manufacturing
record_json: {"key": "australia_crcp_67c5487c469c", "registry": "australia_crcp", "name": "Edge AI for Zero-Defect Automated Manufacturing", "country": "AU", "round": "Successful CRC Projects Round 18", "period": "1 Jul 2026 – 30 Jun 2029", "grant": "$958,581", "project_value": "$3,007,956", "objective_original": "This automation project will integrate Edge AI with advanced sensors to focus on reducing costly defects during die-casting of aluminium EV parts. original_name: Wireless mining conveyor technology to Improve safety and reduce outages
record_json: {"key": "australia_crcp_0d13115c36bd", "registry": "australia_crcp", "name": "Wireless mining conveyor technology to Improve safety and reduce outages", "country": "AU", "round": "Successful CRC Projects Round 11", "period": "1/8/2021 - 29/2/2024", "grant": "$250,000", "project_value": "$626,031", "objective_original": "MineSensor combines proprietary hardware, firmware, software, and an analytics platform to digitise mine conveyor information to reduce breakdown, increase mine output and improve safety. original_name: Commercial scaling of microplastic removal from industrial wastewater
record_json: {"key": "australia_crcp_1750922f267a", "registry": "australia_crcp", "name": "Commercial scaling of microplastic removal from industrial wastewater", "country": "AU", "round": "Successful CRC Projects Round 17", "period": "1 Jun 2025 – 31 May 2027", "grant": "$1,575,371", "project_value": "$3,557,824", "objective_original": "This project aims to build on the successful NSW Small Business Innovation & Research 2021 Water Purification Challenge prototype by scaling and validating a microplastics wastewater purification technology in a real-world setting. {"key": "australia_crcp_026f2c14f1ff", "registry": "australia_crcp", "name": "Manufacturing consortium for cancer radioimmunotherapy", "country": "AU", "round": "Successful CRC Projects Round 9", "period": "1/7/2020 - 30/6/2023", "grant": "$3,000,000", "project_value": "$10,652,883", "objective_original": "GlyTherix is an Australian SME developing antibody treatments for cancer. original_name: Enhanced Influenza Vaccine Production: New vaccine manufacture substrates
record_json: {"key": "australia_crcp_0fbd7b401a53", "registry": "australia_crcp", "name": "Enhanced Influenza Vaccine Production: New vaccine manufacture substrates", "country": "AU", "round": "Successful CRC Projects Round 9", "period": "1/7/2020 - 30/6/2023", "grant": "$2,399,226", "project_value": "$10,833,759", "objective_original": "Influenza (flu) is a global health issue, causing severe illness and deaths each year. Flu vaccines, key to flu prevention, are produced in eggs, a process that suffers considerable production hurdles, using almost 1.6 billion fertilised chicken eggs per year and producing tonnes of flu infected waste. To solve this major industry problem, we have developed new vaccine production substrates (eggs and cell lines) that can produce significantly higher quantities of flu vaccine, alleviating the production hurdles of this vital medical product. This project will take our highly developed prototypes and deliver a translated, commercially viable products for international sale. Our eggs and cell lines will save time, money and lives.", "partners": ["Synbiova Pty Ltd", "CSIRO", "Biointelect Pty Ltd", "Specialised Breeders Australia Pty Ltd", "Valo Biomedia gmbh"]}

record_json: {"key": "australia_crcp_345c958d15fb", "registry": "australia_crcp", "name": "Developing a Scalable Green Plasma-Based Perchlorate Manufacturing Process", "country": "AU", "round": "Successful CRC Projects Round 17", "period": "1 Jul 2025 – 31 Dec 2026", "grant": "$2,796,600", "project_value": "$9,849,225", "objective_original": "Ammonium perchlorate is required for manufacture of energetic materials for defence, a national priority area, as well as for space access, mining and battery manufacturing.
